clue.text: Liberal to stop Trumpist mum backing union?

indicators.note: a stopper plugs a gap, so the Liberal abbreviation is pushed inside the other letters
backing means moving in reverse, so the whole string is read from right to left

blocks.note: the slogan Make America Great Again, worn by Trump supporters
standard abbreviation for Liberal
a familiar word for mother

explanation.surface: A liberal campaigner tries to stop a Trump-supporting mother from backing a trade union.
explanation.walkthrough: MAGA, short for Make America Great Again, is the Trump movement's slogan. The Liberal letter lands between its G and final A.
explanation.definitionFit: An amalgam is a blend or merger of separate things, the same idea as a combining or joining together.

clue.text: Harmony from A string keeping constant

a cord is a length of string

explanation.surface: A musician finds harmony from the A string of an instrument, kept steady and constant.
explanation.walkthrough: A string looks like the violin string tuned to A, but A is just the letter and string is CORD.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in accord means agreeing peacefully, so the noun is a synonym for agreement or concord between parties.

clue.text: Fully informed about rigged Oscars

blocks.note: the film awards, used purely for their letters

explanation.surface: Someone claims inside knowledge that the Academy Awards were fixed.
explanation.definitionFit: To be across a subject is an informal idiom for having thorough knowledge of it and keeping up to date.

clue.text: Cunning traps great many in place of execution …

a lot is a large number
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis runs on into 4/13, whose queen met her end at this device; strictly it is the instrument rather than the place, but the platform it stands on is where executions happened.
explanation.definitionFit: The bladed machine of the French Revolution was the spot where condemned prisoners were beheaded, making it the scene of execution.

clue.text: … royal at one time near it, disastrously

explanation.definitionFit: She was the Austrian-born queen consort of Louis XVI of France, so she is a member of a ruling family.

clue.text: Old style redcoat dancing

indicators.note: dancers move about and change places, so the letters swap around

explanation.definitionFit: The geometric design movement flourished in the 1920s and 1930s, so it is a period look from the past.

clue.text: R u a Vulcan, potentially benevolent?

blocks.note: all the letters of the text-speak question are used

explanation.walkthrough: R u is text-speak for are you; Vulcans in Star Trek are coolly logical, hardly warm.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means behaving like a kindly uncle, so it describes a friendly, well-meaning manner.

clue.text: Uproar among mastodons

blocks.note: the middle letters of the extinct beast's name

explanation.surface: A commotion breaks out in a herd of mastodons.
explanation.definitionFit: A to-do is an informal word for a fuss or commotion, a noisy disturbance.

clue.text: Survey ship looks more defined with this

blocks.note: to eye something is to look it over
an ocean liner is a passenger ship

explanation.surface: An inspection of a vessel reveals sharper lines with some device.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Looks' seems to be a verb after 'ship', but it is the noun: one's appearance, sharpened by make-up.

clue.text: Daughter called number up whenever required

to be called something is to be named it
short for number

clue.text: Dog returned in big rocket

blocks.note: letters spanning the two words

explanation.walkthrough: Dogs famously flew in early Soviet rockets; the answer is the short-legged Welsh breed favoured by the late Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: The corgi is a breed of small herding dog from Wales, an example of the animal named.

clue.text: Ring leader no Royalist

explanation.definitionFit: Roundheads were Parliament's supporters in the English Civil War, fighting against King Charles I's side.

clue.text: Sappers calm crossing island in spring

clue.text: Female the Italian married in Cinema Paradiso say

standard abbreviation for married

explanation.definitionFit: Cinema Paradiso is a well-known Italian motion picture, so it is one instance of the category.

clue.text: See 4

the letters of May rearranged

clue.text: Psychic powers, not a thing exploited, embraced

clue.text: First to sample powdered milk!

clue.text: You bit a child?
